:::{#hero-heading style="font-size: 1.1em;"}
Welcome to the website of the **ONDA** Lab (**O**pen methodologies in **N**eurorehabilitation and **D**ata **A**nalysis)

The Lab is located at [IRCCS San Camillo in Venice](https://hsancamillo.it) its research focuses on
<span style="color:#1b4f72; font-weight:bold;">N</span>eurorehabilitation and in particular on:
<span style="color:#8fc2d7; font-weight:bold;">N</span>europhysiology,
<span style="color:#98cae6; font-weight:bold;">N</span>europsychology, and
<span style="color:#acd6ec; font-weight:bold;">N</span>euroscience.

## Lab philosophy

The Lab philosophy is focused on rigour and **Open Science** principles. We are committed to sharing our code, methods, data, results but also teaching materials and educational resources to the scientific community, to promote transparency, reproducibility and collaboration in research.

## What we do

- We develop open tools for neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation
- We study brain functions and biomarkers using MEEG
- We create open-source pipelines for neural data analysis
- We develop/optimize methods for behavioural and brain data analysis
